general_information.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
general_information.Description: This course is designed to provide students with a understanding of the foundations and the dimensions of Vietnamese culture, origin, characteristic; pay particular attention to the relationship between Vietnamese culture and the present-day life of the Vietnamese people and to the different elements of the culture which are under the social structures, belief systems, literature, arts, customs, etc... Topics mainly include: (1) the foundations of Vietnamese civilization: its geography, language, and history; (2) the core concepts in Vietnamese thoughts and religions: Aninism, Taoism, Buddhism, Confucianism, Catholicism, the new sects religion;...(3) Literature (4) Society and Life, including education, the role of women, Vietnamese food, festivals and leisure activities ; (5) Arts and Architecture (6) Vietnamese performing arts like Ca trù, Tuồng, Hát Bội... -Teaching method: Presentation, Discussion, teamwork, critical thinking, field-trip.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time. - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose. - Promptly access to the FLM at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand the foundations and dimensions of Vietnamese culture. Interpret and absorb the essence of Vietnamese culture.
Explain Vietnam's history and the change of Vietnamese culture over the different historical periods.
Evaluate the problem from the cultural perspective, aesthetic creation and thriving for success in the globalization context.
Developing essential skills in building or constructing a typical product reflecting cultural aspects.
Having a professional attitude, critical thinking and teamwork.

assessments.Grading Guide: Each team needs to create a Timeline of Vietnamese Cultural History (following the timeline from the founding of the country to the present) – Presentation: In-class presentation of 25–30 minutes, followed by 5–10 minutes Q&A. AI usage: AI tools are allowed (for research, analysis, slide design, images, charts, etc.), but the final work must demonstrate critical thinking, creativity, and originality. Submission format: • 01 visual product: timeline infographic (can be presented using Canva, PowerPoint, Notion, Miro, etc.) - format file: JPEG/PNG/PDF • 01 description: explaining the implementation process, reflecting on the role of AI support - format file: Word/PDF
